claims.claim: Gearbox fits Toyota Corolla, Carry, Hilux (implying this unit is for one of these models)
claims.evidence: Witness report shows no tags, stamps, part numbers, or engine codes identifying make/model fitment; identity is only 'by_type: car transmission/gearbox assembly'.

claims.claim: Implied this is a complete, sale-ready automatic or manual gearbox unit
claims.evidence: Photos show bellhousing, torque converter, wiring harness and hoses attached, but no confirmation of internal completeness or that all shown parts are included in the sale.

risks.risk: Functional condition (shift quality, internal wear, fluid condition) cannot be seen from static photos.
risks.proof: Video of gearbox being turned/shifted by hand or bench-tested with fluid, plus input/output shaft rotation check.
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-verified used unit, worst case requiring full rebuild

risks.risk: Unknown exact vehicle fitment (engine/transmission code not visible).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the transmission ID plate, stamped part number, or casting number.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic unmatched gearbox, not model-specific premium

risks.risk: Uncertain whether torque converter, sensors, and wiring harness are included in the sale or just shown for reference.
risks.proof: Seller written itemized list or photo with these parts separated and labeled as included.
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare casing only, accessories not included

risks.risk: Unknown mileage/usage history, risk of hidden internal damage or prior flood/fire exposure.
risks.proof: Photo of donor vehicle or any paperwork/receipt showing provenance.
risks.if_unproven: priced as high-risk used part, no history

risks.risk: No warranty or return policy stated, increasing buyer risk if non-functional after purchase.
risks.proof: Written seller confirmation of warranty/return terms.
risks.if_unproven: priced with no after-sale protection factored in

proof_requests: Close-up photo of transmission ID tag, stamped part/model number, or casting marks
Video of the gearbox being manually shifted through gears or bench-spun to show smooth movement
Itemized list/photo confirming torque converter, sensors, and harness are included in the sale
Any documentation on donor vehicle mileage or part removal reason
Statement on warranty or return policy
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a used car transmission/gearbox assembly, so it can be priced at worst case as an unverified, unmatched, accessory-uncertain used unit, pending proof of fitment and function.
